knobs.note: BH-7303. Read by bin/harness-sync-timer.sh as ${HARNESS_SYNC_PERIOD_MIN:-15}: minutes since the last good sync (state/harness-sync-last-success) and since the timer's last attempt before it runs bin/harness-sync.sh deploy again. Settings row lane.harness-sync-timer.harness_sync_period_min. Below 5 reads as 5, above 240 as 240, a value that is not a whole number as 15.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/harness-sync-timer.sh uses as now (stamp ages and the attempt stamp mtime). Empty = the clock. NOT settable from the control plane; never set it in cron.
